distribution.classification_rule: Every changed distribution path belongs to exactly one category below. The packaged Node executable is the selected runtime. Node headers and build metadata are compile inputs only; npm and Corepack are not invoked by the application-provisioned sidecar. Distribution documentation is discovery material.

tls.official_release_note: crypto: update root certificates to NSS 3.125
tls.root_set_change: 26 prior root identities removed or changed; no target additions
tls.classification: Version-specific provider trust boundary. No endpoint or provider compatibility is inferred. Normal certificate-chain and hostname verification remain enabled.

http1_idle_socket.classification: Selected default Fetch path: idle keep-alive validation moves to a refed setImmediate after poll so queued peer bytes, FIN, or RST are observed before a reused request is written. This changes transport scheduling and closes a stale-socket race; Pi request and response mapping is unchanged.

retry_handler.classification: Not selected: Pi does not inject an Undici RetryAgent or dispatcher; the Pi Codex HTTP path owns retries around globalThis.fetch.

eventsource_parser.classification: Not selected: the Pi SDK sidecar does not instantiate Node EventSource. The Codex SSE response is read through Fetch.

websocket_handshake.classification: Selected for the Pi Codex auto transport: valid WebSocket sessions keep the same wire; a server protocol offered without a client protocol now fails closed rather than dereferencing a null list.

websocket_compression_failure.classification: Selected Codex WebSocket failure path: an over-limit compressed message destroys the inflater after removing listeners, avoiding a later unhandled error. The sidecar wire and message projection are unchanged.

other_node_release_changes.classification: The full distribution inventory is retained. Corepack and npm contents, Node-API headers, ICU and timezone data, c-ares, V8, URL setters, ESM loading, HTTP/2, tests, and build-tool changes do not add a Pi sidecar command, input, permission, mapped event, usage field, or cleanup step. The unchanged Pi 0.84.2 source tuple selects no native-addon build path in Swallowtail. No newly added Node operation is selected.

route_call_path.catalogue: Sidecar creates ModelRuntime with authPath, modelsPath null, and allowModelNetwork false.
route_call_path.session: Sidecar creates the same ModelRuntime; the SDK Agent forwards standard stream options but no fetch, dispatcher, TLS CA, HTTPS agent, proxy, or certificate-verification override.
route_call_path.provider_http: Pi provider HTTP defaults to options.fetch or globalThis.fetch; the sidecar supplies no custom fetch, so Node global Fetch uses its bundled Undici and TLS roots.
route_call_path.provider_websocket: Pi Codex auto transport uses globalThis.WebSocket; Node global WebSocket uses its bundled Undici implementation.
route_call_path.offline_mode: PI_OFFLINE is set to 1 when unset to suppress SDK catalogue networking; this does not disable provider TLS verification or live session work.
